## Checklist

- [ ] The diff is focused and contains no credentials, tokens, databases, backups, or private message data.
- [ ] New behavior was demonstrated by a failing test first and covers relevant success and rejection paths.
- [ ] Focused manual mutation checks were run where behavior changed.
- [ ] The complete test suite passes and branch-aware coverage remains at least 85%.
- [ ] Public schemas and documentation were updated where required.
- [ ] Database changes include a transactional migration, integrity checks, and migration tests.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff, including any agent-assisted output.
